phase3_findings.description: docs/external/rule-sets.md lines 135-140 answer a startup failure about missing tables or columns with plain sqllens validate, which does not run the catalog existence check; that runs under --check-db. The same command is offered at lines 123-128 for a refused account, where it cannot reproduce the refusal either.
docs/external/rule-sets.md line 99 says serve and validate both print a warning for an unconfirmed set; serve logs it instead.

The runner call orders in docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md lines 185 and 191, docs/internal/agent/factory.md line 87 and docs/internal/database-connectors/row-level-security.md line 209 omit the two new runners.
The AGENTS.md architecture tree gains no entry for src/sqllens/rule_sets.py or src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py.
docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md line 3 records a freshness marker seven commits behind the branch head.
src/sqllens/cli.py line 167 separates _unconfirmed_rule_sets from the preceding definition with one blank line instead of two.
docs/external/rule-sets.md line 145 tells the operator to restart the server while the same sentence says the catalog check is retried on the next request.

src/sqllens/preflight.py lines 168-174 turn any non-mismatch catalog failure into a PreflightError carrying only the exception's class name, and the command prints that text alone, so the driver's reason reaches no log; the request-time sibling logs the cause at WARNING.

src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py lines 420-425 test the parse-refusal markers before the already-logged-by-a-guard check, so a guard's internal failure quoting a marker would be reported to the model as a statement to rewrite.

src/sqllens/rule_sets.py lines 214-358 keep several invariants at call sites rather than in the types: the indexed-file docstring, the public confirmed latch written from preflight without the lock, the unbounded rule-set list, and the unconstrained RuleSetSelection.
src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py lines 470-472 rebuild the refusal behind its own constructor, and redacted_refusal_text picks the client-facing kind by matching text owned by other modules.
src/sqllens/config.py RuleSetsConfig can still represent a configured-but-unloaded state for an instance not produced by Config's validator, and every downstream gate keys off the loaded value.
docs/internal/database-connectors/row-level-security.md line 281 said the rule-set key limit counts every _meta key instead of the extras, where both limits in fact apply.
